'''May 2001 Albany tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Albany, NY in May 2001. [[Eric Hunter]] won it. It is known from Eric Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2506">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-24-albany-boston-invades-yet-againd2506/ albany-boston-invades-yet-again], DeckTech (Eric "bounty22" Hunter, 24 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-24-albany-boston-invades-yet-againd2506/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' May 2001
* '''Site:''' Albany, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Eric Hunter]]
